title: Immunohistochemistry for Fetuin-A Detection in Human Autopsy Tissue
author: Miriam Heinen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sydefs6
materials: secondary antibody DAKO REAL Link (APAAP Kit)
Encircle each tissue section with a wax pen
Tip off solution and rinse in demineralized water
Submerge slides in Mayer´s hematoxylin for 1 minute

steps.title: Hybridization oven incubation
steps.instruction: Place slides in a hybridization oven at 37 °C overnight, then increase temperature to 65 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Deparaffinate slides in xylene
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in xylene for three cycles of 20 minutes each (using three separate containers) on a shaker.

steps.title: Rehydrate through graded ethanol
steps.instruction: Rehydrate slides sequentially: 100 % ethanol for three × 2 minutes, then 96 % ethanol for two × 2 minutes, and finally 70 % ethanol for 2 minutes.

steps.title: PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval in citrate buffer
steps.instruction: Place slides in 10 mM citrate buffer and heat in a steamer for 30 minutes. After heating, let slides cool in PBS for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Second PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare primary antibody solution in 1 % bovine serum albumin (BSA) in PBS; add 100 µl per section (negative controls receive only 1 % BSA). Incubate overnight in a moisture chamber.

steps.title: Post‑primary wash
steps.instruction: Tip off excess solution, rinse slides in demineralized water, then wash in PBS for two × 5 minutes.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Apply DAKO REAL Link (APAAP Kit, bottle A) 100 µl per section; incubate 30 minutes in a moisture chamber.

steps.title: Post‑secondary wash
steps.instruction: Tip off excess solution, rinse in demineralized water, then wash in PBS for two × 5 minutes.

steps.title: APAAP immunocomplex incubation
steps.instruction: Apply Dako REAL APAAP Immunocomplex (APAAP Kit, bottle B) 100 µl per section; incubate 30 minutes in a moisture chamber.

steps.title: Post‑immunocomplex wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS for two × 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare chromogenic substrate solution
steps.instruction: To 750 µl of AP Substrate Buffer (APAAP Kit, bottle F) add 30 µl chromogen Red 1 (bottle C), then 30 µl chromogen Red 2 (bottle D), and finally 30 µl chromogen Red 3 (bottle D) in this exact order. Mix well and use within 20 minutes.

steps.title: Apply substrate and develop
steps.instruction: Apply 200 µl of the prepared CHROME substrate per section; incubate for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Final washes and dehydration
steps.instruction: Wash slides in demineralized water for two × 5 minutes, then rinse in running demineralized water for 5 minutes. Dehydrate through graded ethanol: 1 minute in 70 % ethanol, 1 minute in 96 % ethanol, and 2 minutes in 100 % ethanol. Finally, place slides in xylene for three × 1 minute.
